title: "Development"
---

## Tests

The test suite uses Pest and runs on PHP 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5. Tests that use
the `|>` operator are in `tests/Php85`, which `phpunit.xml` loads only on PHP
8.5:

```bash
composer install
php vendor/bin/pest
```

CI runs the suite on Ubuntu with PHP 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5, against PostgreSQL 17
and MySQL 8.0. A second job runs `tests/Polars` on PHP 8.5 with a prebuilt
php_polars extension, and a third runs `composer lint`. CI does not load the
phit extension.

The tests that fit models or use the native CSV reader need the phit extension
and are skipped without it. To run them, load the extension:

```bash
php -d extension=/path/to/libphit.dylib vendor/bin/pest
```

## R comparisons {#comparing-with-r}

Many tests compare phibble with R. Scripts in `tests/r/` run the same
operations in R and write the expected results to `tests/fixtures/`:

| Script | Checks |
| --- | --- |
| `tests/r/print.R` | Printing and `glimpse()` against tibble. |
| `tests/r/io.R` | CSV reading and writing against readr. |
| `tests/r/expr.R` | Expressions against dplyr. |
| `tests/r/expr-types.R` | Aggregate result types against dplyr. |
| `tests/r/lubridate_stringr.R` | Date and string functions against lubridate and stringr. |
| `tests/r/joins.R` | `join_by()` joins against dplyr. |
| `tests/r/pivot.R` | Pivots against tidyr. |
| `tests/r/edge_cases.R` | Prints R's results for the edge cases in `tests/ExprRTest.php`, which hold them as expected values. |

The fixtures are committed, so the tests do not need R.
`tests/r/versions.json` records the R and package versions that reproduce
them byte for byte. After changing a
script, regenerate its fixtures from the repository root, for example with
`Rscript tests/r/expr.R`. The scripts need the tibble, readr, dplyr, tidyr,
stringr, lubridate, and jsonlite packages.

## Database tests

`tests/SqlTest.php` runs against an in-memory SQLite database. It also runs
against PostgreSQL and MySQL when these environment variables hold PDO DSNs:

```bash
export PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL="pgsql:host=127.0.0.1;port=5432;dbname=postgres"
export PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL_USER=postgres
export PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL="mysql:host=127.0.0.1;port=3306"
export PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL_USER=root
```

`PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL_PASSWORD` and `PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL_PASSWORD` set
passwords. The tests only run `SELECT` statements over inline data and create
no tables.

## Verification and benchmark records

phpstats.org renders the JSON records in `site/verifications/` and
`site/benchmarks/`. Scripts write both, and nothing is edited by hand.

`bin/verify` runs the test suite and writes one verification record per
topic. Each case is one test, with the suite's status and skip reason. Set the
database variables above and load phit and php_polars to run every case:

```bash
bin/verify --php="php -d extension=phit.so -d extension=php_polars.so"
```

`bin/bench-record` runs the benchmarks in `bench/` and writes their records.
Each run is a fresh process under `peakmem`, built from phit's
`bench/peakmem.c`. Records come from the Linux benchmark machine only:

```bash
bin/bench-record --php="php -d extension=phit.so -d extension=php_polars.so"
```

`bin/bench` runs one backend in one process and prints its timings, for
quick comparisons while working.

## Functions and methods reference

`bin/api-reference` writes the pages in `docs/reference/` from the public API
by reflection: every function in `Phibble` and `Phibble\Expr`, and every
public method of the table classes and the other public classes it lists.
Text comes from the docblocks. The script fails when a public callable has no
page or no docblock summary, and `tests/SiteTest.php` fails when the pages
are out of date:

```bash
bin/api-reference
```

## Documentation

The site is a Quarto project in `docs/`. Every example is a PHP file in
`docs/examples/`. `bin/docs-examples` runs each example with `docs/examples` as
the working directory and writes its code and output to
`docs/examples/_<name>.md`, which the pages include. Quarto never runs PHP.

`bin/render-docs` refreshes the examples, renders the site, and copies the
result into `docs/`. Commit the rendered HTML, because phpstats.org imports
it from `docs/` and never runs Quarto:

```bash
PHP=php85 bin/render-docs
```

`bin/docs-examples name` refreshes one example. Set `QUARTO` when the `quarto`
command is not on the path.

The documentation is published at <https://phibble.phpstats.org/docs>.
GitHub Pages serves only redirects there: the `pages` workflow runs
`bin/pages-redirects`, which writes one redirect page for each page in
`docs/`.
